title: Japanese Hash and Yautia Cakes
description: A unique fusion of Japanese flavors with Caribbean yautia and crispy hash. A tasty and satisfying snack.
instructions: 1. Peel and dice the yautia into small pieces.
2. In a pan, heat the sesame oil and sauté the yautia until tender.
3. In a separate pan, heat the hash until crispy.
4. In a bowl, mix together the sushi rice vinegar, soy sauce, sugar, and salt.
5. Add the cooked yautia to the bowl and mix well.
6. Add the crispy hash to the bowl and mix until combined.
7. Using your hands, shape the mixture into small patties.
8. Pan-fry the patties until golden brown and crispy.
